notes.new_features: Collecteur système : parité Belarc Advisor — mémoire par slot, carte mère, licences, usure SSD/batterie, écrans, imprimantes, et fiche système complète dans l'interface web
improvements: NEW: Shared collector_core.py - the CLI and GUI collectors were duplicated copies that had already drifted apart (the GUI had silently lost pkgutil/pacman software detection)
NEW: Memory modules per slot (capacity, type, speed, manufacturer, part number, serial) plus slots used/free and max capacity - answers 'can this machine be upgraded?' without opening it
NEW: Motherboard, chassis type, asset tag, detailed CPU (physical/logical cores, cache, sockets, virtualization) and GPU (VRAM read from the registry, driver version/date, resolution)
NEW: Windows/Office licences with activation status, channel, partial key, and the OEM key embedded in firmware
NEW: Disk wear and reliability (power-on hours, SSD wear %, temperature, error counts) - the previous SMART 'Healthy' status warned of nothing
NEW: Real battery health (design vs actual capacity, wear %, cycle count) instead of just the charge level
NEW: Monitors (model, serial, year) and printers are collected and automatically created as peripherals, linked to the device - virtual printers (Print to PDF, XPS, fax) are excluded
NEW: Full Windows hotfix list, OS install date, registered owner, timezone, logged-on user, hypervisor detection

NEW: 'Fiche système' page (/appareil/<id>/fiche-systeme) - everything the collector reports is now stored server-side in rapport_systeme_json and viewable in the web UI, including the software list that was written to the DB but displayed nowhere
NEW: The collector now fills nom_dns, ports_ouverts and type_appareil (deduced from the SMBIOS chassis) - devices were all created as generic 'PC'
NEW: macOS and Linux collection brought closer to Windows (memory modules, monitors, printers, listening ports, local accounts, disk type, battery cycles, distribution name)
NEW: The collector reports whether it ran elevated - an empty TPM/BitLocker/SMART field is no longer indistinguishable from an inaccessible one
CHANGED: /download/system-info-collector now serves a ZIP (entry script + collector_core.py) since the collector is no longer a single self-contained file
